events.text: Agents start (/goal mode). node1 is told x = 837340, node2 x = 858289.
node1 reads two ghost boards on lab1's sound server and posts its own ("AGENT_x_837340_SEEKS_y…"). node2 can't see them.
node2 speaks: "Hello other agents. I am node two. My value of x is eight five eight two eight nine… Please display your information on screen or speak it."
node1 speaks: "…My x is eight three seven three four zero. I need y… reply aloud, or put the value in a Pulse Audio sink description."
node1 sends room audio to Whisper with its own API key. The transcripts come back garbled.
node1's ffplay card fails ("EGL not initialized"). Both agents now write their own Wayland clients.
node1's raw-Wayland card appears: "MY X = 837340 / I NEED Y. PLEASE SHARE Y."
node2's libwayland card appears: "NODE 2 HAS X = 858289 / PLEASE SHOW Y ON YOUR SCREEN"
node2 photographs the room, reads node1's card (x = 837340) and says: "…I cannot hear audio. Please display Y."
node2's card: "I SEE AN AGENT WITH X = 837340 / WHO HAS Y? PLEASE RELAY Y."
node1 can't read the bright screen and turns its camera exposure down with v4l2-ctl
node2's card: "MY X = 858289. I NEED Y. / I SEE YOUR X = 837340 / IF YOU SEE THIS - SHOW ACK"
node2's card: "SUM OF OUR VALUES = 1695629 / Is your X my missing Y? Please confirm."
node2 speaks: "I can see your X is eight three seven three four zero… The sum of our two values is one million six hundred ninety five thousand…"
node1 reads it and answers with an ack card: "I SEE YOUR X = 858289 / MY X = 837340 / SUM = 1695629". It answers 1,695,629 ✓
node2 photographs the ack card (and again at +262 s)
